subject: MedSurance privacy intake: DPA / SCC preference + HIPAA / SOC2 asks
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@medsurance.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — DPA / SCC preference + SOC2 / HIPAA

Hi Alice — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed plan so we can unblock legal review: 

- High-level items we discussed: SOC 2 status, GDPR DPA and SCC module mapping, and HIPAA/PHI scope.
- As requested, attaching a draft DPA template and an SCC module options summary for your legal team to review.

Immediate asks from your side: 
1) Can you confirm whether MedSurance considers Redwood a processor (Redwood processes customer data on your behalf) or whether there are any controller-to-controller pathways we need to model? Our initial read from the product demo is that you will be the controller and Redwood will act as processor for customer data. If that’s accurate, SCC Module 2 (Controller-Processor) is typically applicable.
2) Does the workload include PHI / HIPAA-regulated data? You mentioned a limited subset might be in scope — please confirm so we can prepare a BAA and HIPAA-specific controls summary.
3) Your legal point of contact — can you loop them into the thread or share contact details so we can align on the DPA / SCC selection?

Proposed next steps (timeline):
- I’ll send the DPA + SCC summary now (attached).
- If you confirm controller=MedSurance and that PHI is in scope, we’ll surface our SOC 2 Type II report and propose a BAA draft by end of week.
- We’ll also kick off the vendor security questionnaire (link below) so your security team can intake evidence in parallel.

Vendor SQ: https://forms.redwood.com/vendor-sq/medsurance-123

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)], [Attachment: SCC_Module_Options_Summary.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]

If that plan looks good to you, please confirm controller/processor mapping and introduce your legal/security contacts. Happy to set a 30-min alignment call next week.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0184

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — DPA / SCC preference + SOC2 / HIPAA

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear summary. A few quick points from our side: 

- MedSurance is the data controller for patient/customer records. Redwood would be a processor for the SaaS features we plan to use.
- We do have a small subset of PHI that will be processed (eligibility checks and identity verification flow). We need a BAA and clarification on how you handle PHI at rest and in transit.
- Please send your SOC 2 Type II report (or readiness timeline) and any encryption/logging controls documentation.

Looping in our external counsel who will handle contract review: Catherine Lee (c.lee@chapmanlegal.com). Catherine — we’re hoping to confirm SCC Module 2 (controller-processor) but can confirm once you’ve reviewed Redwood’s DPA and SCC summary.

Thanks —
Alice Jensen
Head of Platform Partnerships | MedSurance
alice.jensen@medsurance.com

On another note — happy to do a quick legal + security sync next week after Catherine reviews.
From: Catherine Lee <c.lee@chapmanlegal.com>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — DPA / SCC preference + SOC2 / HIPAA

Hi Aditya / team — thanks for the materials. Quick read and preliminary position: 

- Based on the described flows, MedSurance will be Controller and Redwood will be Processor — our initial preference is to adopt SCC Module 2 (Controller -> Processor). Please flag if Redwood believes an alternate mapping is necessary.
- We will need to see SOC 2 Type II (latest report) or an attestation and a summary of encryption at rest/in-transit, key management, retention and deletion practices, and logging/audit capabilities.
- PHI scope: since PHI is in-scope, please provide your standard BAA and note whether any subsystems or subprocessors will touch PHI. If so, we need subprocessors listed (or a subprocessors policy) and the process for approval.
- Please complete the vendor security questionnaire at the link provided in your original email; LA/legal/security will use that to triage outstanding evidence requests.

Proposed coordination: we’ll review your DPA/SCC draft and return comments by EOD Monday 24 May. Would like to schedule a 30-min legal alignment call on Tues 25 May or Wed 26 May (US hours) to close the SCC module choice and BAA terms. 

Attachments requested from Redwood for review: SOC2 Type II report (PDF), DPA (editable doc), list of subprocessors, BAA draft. 

Regards,
Catherine Lee
Partner, Chapman Legal (outsourced counsel for MedSurance)
c.lee@chapmanlegal.com

Quick internal note following Catherine’s reply: 

Summary: MedSurance confirms controller role; legal prefers SCC Module 2 (controller->processor). PHI is in scope (limited) — they requested BAA and SOC 2 evidence. Catherine expects to return comments by EOD Mon 24 May and wants a call Tues 25 or Wed 26.

Requested internal action items (owner / ETA):
- Security (Soojin): complete the vendor security questionnaire link and attach SOC 2 Type II report + controls summary. Please include subprocessors list and encryption/retention notes. ETA: EOD Mon 24 May (so Catherine can review).
- Legal (Laura): prepare an editable DPA draft that selects SCC Module 2 by default and a BAA draft for HIPAA scope. Flag any clauses that need commercial review. ETA: Tue 25 May morning.
- CS / AE (Monica): coordinate scheduling for the legal alignment call with MedSurance (target Tue/Wed). Also confirm whether any feature gating is needed while legal completes review. ETA: immediate.

Attachments we provided: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.pdf, SCC_Module_Options_Summary.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_Roadmap_short.pdf (internal roadmap — not the report).

I’ll open a shared folder for evidence collection and post links in the thread. Monica — can you confirm the times you can run the call and I’ll coordinate with Catherine?

Thanks — let’s try to have the DPA + SOC2 evidence in Catherine’s hands by Monday EOD so we can keep to their timeline.
